headline: PML-N's Muhammad Asad Hanif Jutt won Sahiwal's PP-203 by-election with 42,114 votes against 24,512 for TEP's Muhammad Awais Mahmood, according to the Form-47 seen by Dawn, while counting was underway in Gujranwala's NA-77.

card.desc: Asad Hanif Jutt ko 42,114, TEP ke Awais Mahmood ko 24,512 votes

caption:
PP-203 Sahiwal ka by-election PML-N ne jeet liya!
Dawn ke mutabiq Form-47 ke tehat PML-N ke Muhammad Asad Hanif Jutt ne 42,114 votes liye, jabke Tehreek-i-Ehsas Pakistan ke Muhammad Awais Mahmood ko 24,512 votes mile. Turnout 27.6 per cent raha, aur Gujranwala ke NA-77 mein vote ki ginti abhi jari hai.
Kya aap ne is by-election mein vote dala? Comment mein batayein 👇
